note: Original fictional story. Characters, shop and story are invented; no real person or brand is depicted.

assets.name: Linh
assets.identity: Vietnamese woman, 27, slender, long straight black hair in a low ponytail, oval face, tired gentle eyes, no makeup

wardrobe.default: beige trench coat over a cream knit sweater, dark red wool scarf, black trousers, small silver earrings

voice.instructions: Giọng nữ trẻ Hà Nội, nhỏ nhẹ, kìm nén xúc động.

assets.name: Ông Khải
assets.identity: Vietnamese man, 72, lean, short white hair, thin white moustache, deep laugh lines, a jeweller's loupe pushed up on his forehead

wardrobe.default: faded grey wool cardigan over a white collared shirt, brown canvas work apron, sleeves rolled to the forearm

voice.instructions: Giọng ông cụ Hà Nội, trầm, chậm rãi, ấm áp.

assets.name: Ngõ nhỏ đêm mưa phùn
assets.identity: narrow Hanoi alley at night in fine drizzle, wet cobbles reflecting light, peeling ochre walls, tangled power lines, one small old shopfront with a warm-lit window and a faded hand-painted signboard showing a clock icon, no readable words

assets.name: Tiệm sửa đồng hồ
assets.identity: tiny cluttered watch-repair shop interior, wooden workbench with a green felt mat under a brass lamp, walls covered with dozens of old wall clocks, glass-front drawers of tiny parts, rain-streaked front window, warm amber light

assets.name: Đồng hồ quả quýt
assets.identity: old brass pocket watch with a worn engraved lid, white enamel dial with black Roman numerals, hands stopped at 5:47, short brass chain

assets.name: Mẩu giấy gấp
assets.identity: small square of yellowed paper folded four times, faint blue ink handwriting showing through, words not legible

assets.name: Linh (lời kể)
assets.identity: narrator: Linh's inner voice, first person

voice.instructions: Giọng nữ trẻ kể chuyện, thì thầm, chậm, xúc động.

shots.lighting: cold blue night drizzle, one warm amber shop window glowing
shots.action: The empty alley in the drizzle; the warm window of the old watch shop glows at the end.
shots.end_state: closer on the glowing shop window
shots.narration: Bố em mất được ba tháng. Chiếc đồng hồ của bố cũng đứng yên từ hôm ấy.

shots.lighting: cold blue drizzle, warm window light on her face
shots.action: Linh stands under the shop's dripping awning, looking down at the pocket watch in her open palm.
shots.end_state: Linh lifts her eyes to the shop door
shots.narration: Người ta bảo đầu ngõ này còn một ông thợ chữa được đồng hồ cũ.

shots.lighting: warm brass lamp pool, clocks glinting in the dark
shots.action: Ông Khải looks up from his workbench over his glasses as the door opens, a tiny screwdriver still in hand.
shots.start_state: Ông Khải bent over a watch movement
shots.end_state: Ông Khải smiling toward the door

dialogue.speaker: char_ong_khai
dialogue.text: Mưa thế này mà vẫn có khách. Vào đây cho ấm, cháu.

shots.lighting: warm brass lamp pool, clocks glinting in the dark
shots.action: Linh sets the pocket watch gently on the green felt mat and slides it forward.
shots.start_state: watch in Linh's hand above the mat

dialogue.speaker: char_linh
dialogue.text: Ông xem giúp cháu ạ. Nó đứng ở năm giờ bốn mươi bảy, ba tháng nay rồi.

shots.lighting: lamp reflection sliding across the glass
shots.action: Extreme close-up of the white dial, hands frozen at 5:47, lamplight reflected in the glass.
shots.narration: Năm giờ bốn mươi bảy. Giờ bố đi làm về. Tối nào bố cũng ngồi lên dây cót cho nó.

shots.lighting: warm brass lamp pool, clocks glinting in the dark
shots.action: Ông Khải pries open the back case with a thin blade, lowers his loupe, then pauses, surprised.
shots.end_state: his eyebrows rising behind the loupe

dialogue.speaker: char_ong_khai
dialogue.text: Máy vẫn tốt. Chỉ là lâu không ai lên dây thôi. Nhưng trong nắp có cái này.

shots.lighting: hard little spot of lamplight on brass
shots.action: Brass tweezers lift a tiny folded square of yellowed paper out of the inside of the watch lid.
shots.start_state: folded paper tucked in the lid
shots.end_state: paper held up in the tweezers

shots.lighting: warm brass lamp pool between them
shots.action: Across the workbench, Ông Khải holds the folded note out to Linh with both hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_ong_khai
dialogue.text: Hình như cái này là để cho cháu.

shots.lighting: warm lamp from below, tears catching the light
shots.action: Linh unfolds the note and reads; her lips tremble and her eyes fill with tears.

dialogue.speaker: char_linh
dialogue.text: Linh ơi, đồng hồ này phải lên dây mỗi tối. Nếu con quên, mang đến ông Khải đầu ngõ. Ông ấy là bạn thân nhất của bố.

shots.lighting: warm brass lamp pool, clocks glinting in the dark
shots.action: Ông Khải takes off his loupe, eyes wet, smiling; he slowly winds the watch crown between his fingers.

dialogue.speaker: char_ong_khai
dialogue.text: Bố cháu dặn ông từ năm ngoái rồi. Ông ấy bảo, thế nào con bé cũng đến.

shots.lighting: lamp reflection, a glint on the moving second hand
shots.action: Close on the dial: the thin second hand starts to move again past the Roman numerals.
shots.narration: Chiếc đồng hồ chạy lại. Lần đầu tiên sau ba tháng.

shots.lighting: warm window glow, drizzle easing to a few drops
shots.action: From the alley we see through the rain-streaked shop window: Ông Khải pouring tea for Linh at the workbench, both smiling.
shots.start_state: the two figures at the warm window
shots.end_state: the small window in the dark alley, rain stopping
shots.narration: Hóa ra bố không chỉ để lại cho em một chiếc đồng hồ. Bố để lại cho em một người, để kể chuyện về bố.
